title: Fieldwork Express — Grandfather storyteller audition 01
status: Awaiting owner listening review; not the full narration
text:
[softly] Well now... there you are. Come a little closer.
Do you see that tiny seed, beside the train? It has never seen a mountain. Or heard the rain.
[chuckles] And yet... it is looking for a home.
So, shall we help it find one?
First, we'll need some ground. Then a little water... and a place where the wind is kind.
Come along. Our story starts with one small hill.
